description: Santa Ana, CA— On the heels of receiving key endorsements from Assemblywoman Cheryl Brown and Orange County Civil Rights Leader Sylvia Mendez, today, former State Senator Lou Correa secured backing from Congresswoman Lucille Roybal-Allard in his campaign to represent CD-46 in Congress.
